result.summary: Vardhit Auto Components has one open overdue invoice of INR 7.0m, now 36 days past due (original due 2026-10-18), against total exposure of INR 26m on the single TCI policy (limit INR 60m). This is a marked deterioration versus the last four resolved notifications, which were all cleared within 3-6 days of due date over the preceding ~10 months. While notification frequency itself is not accelerating (2 in the last 6 months vs 3 prior), the severity of the current overdue - now 6x longer than any prior late payment - warrants closer monitoring and possible limit review.
concerns: Current overdue (36 DPD) is far longer than the historical pattern of 3-6 days late, indicating a sudden shift in payment reliability
All notifications stem from a single policy/insurer (TCI), so there is no cross-validation from other credit insurers on this buyer's behaviour
No resolution date yet for the open overdue, so true days-late could extend further and compound the deterioration
